contract.clear: Render_BuildActorRecords clears the latch before its six-digit HUD loop.
contract.leading_zeroes: ASCII zero digits are skipped while the latch is clear.
contract.first_nonzero: The first nonzero digit sets the latch and emits a sprite record; all subsequent digits are emitted.

conclusion: FFF0FE is a per-build HUD leading-zero suppression latch.
